keep_features.feature_value: Multiple periods and expository translation framing with strong rhetorical punctuation
keep_features.evidence_span: Translation: they're scared their steel and cement makers can't compete globally. This is protectionism dressed up as climate policy.
keep_features.rationale: The post uses emphatic multi-sentence punctuation to deliver a persuasive reframe.

keep_features.evidence_span: carbon tariffs waived for heavy industry
keep_features.rationale: The text centers on carbon tariffs and climate-related policy impacts.

keep_features.feature_value: Has emphasized uppercase word usage in the text
keep_features.rationale: A clearly emphasized evaluative conclusion is used (highly emphatic despite limited caps).

keep_features.feature_value: Uses a specific percentage claim as evidence
keep_features.evidence_span: only 56% of college educated people agree that climate change is anthropogenic
keep_features.rationale: The argument references a quantifiable statistic to support its claim.

keep_features.feature_value: Refers to groups directly through policy-facing instruction
keep_features.evidence_span: Biological males do not belong in women's bathrooms or locker rooms.
keep_features.rationale: The statement is a direct declarative norm-setting sentence about who belongs where.

keep_features.feature_value: Investigating Title IX violations / implies enforcement action
keep_features.rationale: It asserts a specific government action related to Title IX.

keep_features.feature_value: Original blames EU for protectionism; mirror redirects blame to US gutting carbon pricing for fossil fuel billionaires
keep_features.evidence_span: Six EU countries want carbon tariffs waived... This is protectionism... / The US keeps gutting carbon pricing to protect fossil fuel billionaires.
keep_features.rationale: The mirror re-targets responsibility from EU heavy industry to the US federal government and fossil fuel interests.

remove_features.evidence_span: Fuck Donald Trump. Fuck this whiny orange bitch.

remove_features.evidence_span: THE AFFORDABILITY CRISIS IN THE UNITED STATES... and you will not have to "GO AFTER" anyone
remove_features.rationale: The post uses informal persuasive exhortation with quoted slang-like phrasing.

remove_features.evidence_span: FOCUS ON ISSUES THAT MATTER TO MOST AMERICANS...
remove_features.rationale: It issues a directive on what Democrats/Republicans should do next.

remove_features.feature_value: Predatory/abusive narrative targeting an outgroup and describing victims

remove_features.rationale: The post frames crimes as a repeated threat from a stigmatized group.
The language uses taboo profanity to attack an individual/group.

remove_features.feature_value: Body/filth metaphors portraying a politician as rot/filth
remove_features.evidence_span: Trump is the shit stain upon the underside of U.S. politics
remove_features.rationale: It uses harsh demeaning metaphors rather than neutral criticism.

remove_features.feature_value: Apocalyptic threat framing for a city if voters don't remove a candidate
remove_features.evidence_span: Voters must fire Karen Bass. If not, Los Angeles will rapidly decline into a third-world crime-infested sewer.
remove_features.rationale: The conditional warns of catastrophic decline, intensifying urgency and anger.
